supplementalBaselines.disposition: Keep previously inspected sources separate; investigate additions, removal and replacement. Do not merge incompatible version behavior.
Historical behavior only; investigate current replacements. Do not describe deprecated workflows as current 5.8 functionality.

additionalVersionDiscovery.openIssue: New official engine corpora are retained separately. Determine supported versions and all added/removed/changed feature contracts; do not describe the 6000.0 baseline as the newest or silently waive later additions.

scopeExpansion: Any official functionality reference discovered in manuals/APIs/packages/plugins registers another source or work item. These roots are starting points, not a feature exclusion list.
